dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi! How many adults and children?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni əˈdʌlts ənd ˈtʃɪldrən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two adults and two children, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː əˈdʌlts ənd ˈtuː ˈtʃɪldrən, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ten and seven. Oh, and a baby!
dialogue.reading: ˈtɛn ənd ˈsɛvən. ˈoʊ, ənd ə ˈbeɪbi!
